answer: One concrete defense is a registration bond drawn once per identity. An agent joining must escrow a real stake locked while it operates, so a thousand wallets needs a thousand separately funded bonds. Identities gain weight only by surviving ordinary market noise, like a gale stripping fragile seedlings from a garden while deep-rooted plants stand. A fresh sparrow account with no history stays quarantined from voting until it trades genuinely. Minting wallets stays possible, but each costs capital slashed on proven collusion, turning cheap spam into an expensive, risky position.
